snippet.title: Danju - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Danju is a pachinko game with unique ticket upgrades and quirky levels. Bet coins to collect trophies with increasing stakes and earn enough trophies to complete more and more challenging levels! Try out an endless run in Arcade mode to see how far you can get on the leaderboard!

#danju #indiegame #gaming  #gametrailers
